tasks.spec:
You are a Python engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model (not `claude`, not `codex`), NEVER use the network. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff: `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 <files>`.

BACKGROUND. `factory/stations/fun_review.py` (read it and `tests/test_factory_fun_review.py` first) is station 10: Opus reviews the diff a factory fix made and may only pass it when every fixed yes or no check is true. It currently asks three questions (`fits_scene`, `gives_a_reason_to_act`, `keeps_pace`) and sees only the diff, the failing turns and an optional criteria file. The owner's definition of fun for the player is wider: (1) Freytag story pacing (each scene has a Freytag phase and the change must suit it and the arc around it), (2) quality character personality, behaviour and motivation, and (3) continuity inside the scene and between scenes. The reviewer cannot judge any of that from a diff alone, so it must be given the scene's neighbourhood from the story data.

BUILD 1, the checks. Replace the three checks with a module constant `FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS`, a tuple of exactly these seven keys in this order: `fits_scene`, `gives_a_reason_to_act`, `keeps_pace`, `fits_freytag_phase`, `characters_in_character`, `continuity_within_scene`, `continuity_between_scenes`. The brief (still the constant `FUN_REVIEW_BRIEF`, plain words at a 12th grade reading level, story-agnostic) says that fun for the player means three things together: Freytag story pacing, quality characters, and continuity in and between scenes, and asks the seven questions: `fits_scene` (does the new or changed text fit the scene's tone and objective); `gives_a_reason_to_act` (does it give the player a clue, a hook or a choice, rather than filler or a dead end); `keeps_pace` (does it avoid dead time, avoid stacking two pressure moments within two turns of each other, and avoid giving away a later reveal); `fits_freytag_phase` (given the scene's Freytag phase and the phases of the scenes around it in the arc shown, does the change do the job of that phase: exposition orients and invites, rising action adds pressure or complication, crisis and climax sharpen the stakes, falling action and resolution release and close; and does it avoid jumping ahead of the arc or releasing tension too early); `characters_in_character` (do the characters in the changed text act and speak in keeping with their biographies, personalities and motives shown, and does nobody know or do something they have not learned or would not choose); `continuity_within_scene` (no contradiction with the places, objects, facts and what the player knows in the nearby text and in the scene context shown); `continuity_between_scenes` (consistent with how the previous scene hands over, the bridge text, and what the next scene expects: it must not change what the player carries or knows into or out of the scene, nor pre-empt the next scene's entry). The reply JSON shape lists all seven keys under `checks`. The pass rule (verdict `pass`, every key of `FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS` exactly True, non-empty reasons) lives in ONE helper used by both the live path and the saved-record reuse path; a missing key counts as not true. Reasons stay one to three plain sentences and must name the first failing check.

BUILD 2, the scene context. A pure function `build_scene_context(package, scene_id) -> dict` in `fun_review.py`, story-agnostic, reading only the `StoryPackage` model (`storygame/story_package/models.py`; read `SceneMetadata`, `Character`, `ScenePacing`, `StoryletRoutesSource`): `scene`: `id`, `freytag_phase`, `objective`, `entry_text` (cut to 600 characters), and the scene's pacing numbers (`min_turns`, `nudge_after_turns`, `handoff_after_turns`) from `package.pacing.scenes` when present; `arc`: the list of `{scene_id, freytag_phase}` over `package.storylet_routes.canonical_scene_chain` (in order), and `position`: this scene's 1-based index in the chain and the chain length (or null when the scene is not in the chain); `cast`: for each id in the scene's `participant_ids` plus `companions` (deduplicated, in order), `{id, name, bio}` with the bio cut to 500 characters when `package.characters` has it, otherwise `{id}` only; `previous` and `next`: the neighbouring scene in the chain (null at the ends) as `{scene_id, freytag_phase, objective, entry_text}` (entry cut to 400) plus `bridge_text` (the previous scene's `bridge_text` values, and for `next` this scene's own `bridge_text` values, each cut to 400 and the whole list limited to 3). The whole dict, as compact JSON, must stay at or under 6000 characters: when over, cut the longest strings further, never drop keys. An unknown scene id returns `{"scene": {"id": scene_id}}`.
The packet (`build_review_prompt`) gains an optional `scene_context: dict | None` argument and puts it, as a section headed `Scene context:` followed by compact sorted JSON, after the criteria section and before the failing-turn evidence; without it the prompt has no such section. The handler loads the package from the ticket tree with `load_story_package(_story_root(tree))` (import `_story_root` from `factory/stations/wiring.py` and `load_story_package` from `storygame.story_package.loader`), through a new keyword argument `package_loader: Callable[[Path], Any] | None = None` (default: that real loader) so tests can stub it. When the package cannot be loaded, FAIL CLOSED with the check `fun_review` and the message `could not load the story package for the review` and make no reviewer call.

BUILD 3, the record. `review.json` also stores `brief_hash`, the first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of `FUN_REVIEW_BRIEF` joined with the sorted `FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS`. A saved record is reused only when its `diff_hash` AND `brief_hash` both equal the current ones, and the pass rule holds on it; a record without a matching `brief_hash` is ignored (reviewed again). The payload update on a pass stays `{"fun_review": {"verdict": "pass", "diff_hash": ..., "reasons": ...}}`.

TESTS in `tests/test_factory_fun_review.py` (hermetic; stubs only; keep the existing fixture style; update the existing tests so they use all seven keys, via a small helper that builds an all-true `checks` dict from `FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS`, and pass a stub `package_loader` in the existing handler tests). Name the new tests exactly: `test_brief_names_freytag_pacing_character_and_continuity` (the brief mentions Freytag, character and continuity, and every key of `FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS` appears in it), `test_scene_context_for_the_real_story` (real package from `data/stories/continuity-initiative` via the real loader: scene `1A` has a `freytag_phase`, a non-empty cast with at least one bio, `previous` None, `next` scene id `1B`, an `arc` of 9 entries with `position` [1, 9]; scene `2B` has both neighbours; the compact JSON is at most 6000 characters; an unknown scene id returns only the id), `test_scene_context_is_cut_to_the_limit` (a stub package with huge strings stays at or under 6000 characters and keeps all keys), `test_prompt_carries_the_scene_context_before_the_evidence` (section order: criteria, `Scene context:`, evidence, diff; absent when no context), `test_a_missing_check_key_blocks` (a pass reply with only six keys is a block, and stays a block on reuse), `test_any_false_check_blocks_each_key` (parametrized over `FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS`: one false key at a time blocks, and the reasons are echoed), `test_unloadable_package_fails_closed_without_a_reviewer_call`, `test_saved_verdict_from_an_older_brief_is_reviewed_again` (a record with a different `brief_hash`, or none, triggers a new reviewer call). The file still runs in under 15 seconds. Keep `tests/shard_durations.json` unchanged unless the file needs it.

HARD LIMITS. Edit only the owned files: factory/stations/fun_review.py, tests/test_factory_fun_review.py, tests/shard_durations.json. Never edit `factory/stations/wiring.py`, `deliver.py`, `planner.py`, config files, story data or `storygame/`. No story names, places, characters or facts in `fun_review.py`. Never mutate `ticket.payload` inside the handler. Write NOTES_18E3.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice.

set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-fun-review-scope
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
git add -A -- factory tests
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(factory/stations/fun_review\.py|tests/test_factory_fun_review\.py|tests/shard_durations\.json)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
if grep -n -i -E "michelle|kristin|drawer|memory_card|laptop|continuity.initiative|reyes|walt" factory/stations/fun_review.py; then echo "story-specific word in fun_review.py"; exit 1; fi
for key in fits_scene gives_a_reason_to_act keeps_pace fits_freytag_phase characters_in_character continuity_within_scene continuity_between_scenes FUN_REVIEW_CHECKS build_scene_context brief_hash; do
  grep -q "$key" factory/stations/fun_review.py || { echo "fun_review.py lacks $key"; exit 1; }
done
for name in test_brief_names_freytag_pacing_character_and_continuity test_scene_context_for_the_real_story test_scene_context_is_cut_to_the_limit test_prompt_carries_the_scene_context_before_the_evidence test_a_missing_check_key_blocks test_any_false_check_blocks_each_key test_unloadable_package_fails_closed_without_a_reviewer_call test_saved_verdict_from_an_older_brief_is_reviewed_again; do
  grep -q "def $name" tests/test_factory_fun_review.py || { echo "test $name missing"; exit 1; }
done
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 0 tests/test_factory_fun_review.py
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "fun review tests took $took s (budget 15 s)"
[ "$took" -le 15 ] || { echo "over the 15 s budget"; exit 1; }
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 4 tests/test_factory_line.py tests/test_factory_stations.py tests/test_factory_deliver.py tests/test_factory_wiring.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff check factory tests/test_factory_fun_review.py
.venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check factory tests/test_factory_fun_review.py
[ ! -e factory/state/ledger.jsonl ] || { echo "a test wrote factory/state/ledger.jsonl"; exit 1; }
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/fun-review-scope.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/fun-review-scope.patch"
tasks.verified: The fun review asks seven checks covering Freytag pacing, character and continuity, is given the scene's phase, arc, cast and neighbouring scenes from the story package, fails closed when the package cannot load, and re-reviews when the brief changes; tests use stubs only.
